APPENDIX · GLOSSARY

## A {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-a}

**α (alpha).** The probability of a type I error — rejecting a true null hypothesis. Conventional values are 0.05 and 0.01. [Hypothesis testing p values type i ii errors](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-hypothesis-testing-p-values-type-i-ii-errors).

**ANCOVA.** Analysis of covariance: a linear model combining categorical predictors and continuous covariates, commonly used to adjust RCT analyses for baseline. [Ancova in rcts baseline adjustment](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-ancova-in-rcts-baseline-adjustment).

**ANOVA.** Analysis of variance: a linear model with categorical predictors. [One way anova and contrasts emmeans](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-one-way-anova-and-contrasts-emmeans).

**Assumption.** A condition the chosen test needs to be interpretable — normality, equal variance, independence, linearity. [Two sample and paired t tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-two-sample-and-paired-t-tests).

## B {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-b}

**Bias.** Systematic deviation of an estimator from the quantity being estimated. [Populations samples and the central limit theorem](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-populations-samples-and-the-central-limit-theorem).

**Bootstrap.** Resampling with replacement to approximate the sampling distribution of a statistic. [Bootstrap and permutation tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-bootstrap-and-permutation-tests).

**Brier score.** Mean squared error between predicted probabilities and observed outcomes. [Calibration discrimination roc auc brier score](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-calibration-discrimination-roc-auc-brier-score).

## C {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-c}

**CI (confidence interval).** A range of plausible values for a parameter; in repeated sampling, 95% CIs cover the true value 95% of the time. [Bootstrap and permutation tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-bootstrap-and-permutation-tests).

**Cohen's d.** Standardised difference in means; a common effect size for two-group comparisons. [Two sample and paired t tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-two-sample-and-paired-t-tests).

**Competing risk.** An event whose occurrence precludes or alters the probability of the event of interest. [Competing risks and multistate models](#sec-chapters-11-survival-labs-lab-competing-risks-and-multistate-models).

**Confounding.** A third variable distorting the association between exposure and outcome. [Multiple regression confounding interaction centring](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-multiple-regression-confounding-interaction-centring).

**Cox model.** A proportional-hazards regression for time-to-event outcomes. [Survival primer km log rank cox ph](#sec-chapters-11-survival-labs-lab-survival-primer-km-log-rank-cox-ph).

**CV (cross-validation).** Splitting data into folds to estimate generalisation error. [Cross validation nested cv bootstrap 632](#sec-chapters-13-ml-labs-lab-cross-validation-nested-cv-bootstrap-632).

## D {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-d}

**DAG (directed acyclic graph).** A graphical representation of causal assumptions. [Dags with dagitty and ggdag](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-dags-with-dagitty-and-ggdag).

## E {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-e}

**Effect size.** A standardised measure of the magnitude of an effect, independent of sample size. [Two sample and paired t tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-two-sample-and-paired-t-tests).

## F {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-f}

**FDR (false discovery rate).** The expected proportion of false positives among rejected nulls. [Fdr knockoffs replication crisis](#sec-chapters-13-ml-labs-lab-fdr-knockoffs-replication-crisis).

**Fisher's exact test.** Exact test of independence for 2×2 tables, appropriate when expected cell counts are small. [Two proportions chi square risk and odds](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-two-proportions-chi-square-risk-and-odds).

## G {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-g}

**GAM (generalised additive model).** A regression with smooth non-linear terms, fitted via penalised splines. [Gams with mgcv](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-gams-with-mgcv).

**GEE (generalised estimating equations).** A marginal-model approach for clustered or repeated data. [Glmms and gee](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-glmms-and-gee).

**GLM (generalised linear model).** A regression with a link function and exponential-family error. [Logistic regression binomial glm](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-logistic-regression-binomial-glm).

## H {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-h}

**Hazard ratio.** Ratio of hazard rates between two groups in a survival model. [Survival primer km log rank cox ph](#sec-chapters-11-survival-labs-lab-survival-primer-km-log-rank-cox-ph).

## I {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-i}

**ICC (intraclass correlation).** Proportion of variance attributable to clustering. [Kappa icc bland altman](#sec-chapters-14-clinical-labs-lab-kappa-icc-bland-altman).

**Interaction.** The effect of one predictor depends on the value of another. [Multiple regression confounding interaction centring](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-multiple-regression-confounding-interaction-centring).

**IPTW (inverse-probability-of-treatment weighting).** Propensity-score method that reweights observations to emulate a trial. [Propensity scores and iptw](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-propensity-scores-and-iptw).

## K {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-k}

**Kaplan-Meier.** Non-parametric estimator of the survival function. [Survival primer km log rank cox ph](#sec-chapters-11-survival-labs-lab-survival-primer-km-log-rank-cox-ph).

**Kruskal-Wallis.** Non-parametric one-way ANOVA on ranks. [Non parametric tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-non-parametric-tests).

## L {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-l}

**Lasso.** L1-regularised regression; produces sparse coefficient estimates. [Regularisation ridge lasso elastic net](#sec-chapters-13-ml-labs-lab-regularisation-ridge-lasso-elastic-net).

**Likelihood.** The probability of the observed data under a model, viewed as a function of the parameters. [Maximum likelihood estimation](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-maximum-likelihood-estimation).

**Linear model.** A model of the form $y = X\beta + \varepsilon$. [Simple linear regression](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-simple-linear-regression).

**Logistic regression.** GLM with a logit link for binary outcomes. [Logistic regression binomial glm](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-logistic-regression-binomial-glm).

## M {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-m}

**MAR (missing at random).** Missingness depends on observed variables only. [Mcar mar mnar](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-mcar-mar-mnar).

**MCAR (missing completely at random).** Missingness is independent of all variables. [Mcar mar mnar](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-mcar-mar-mnar).

**MCMC.** Markov-chain Monte Carlo; the Bayesian posterior-sampling workhorse. [Brms stan loo hierarchical models](#sec-chapters-10-bayesian-labs-lab-brms-stan-loo-hierarchical-models).

**MDE (minimum detectable effect).** Smallest effect your study has power to detect. [Power closed form and simulation](#sec-chapters-05-power-labs-lab-power-closed-form-and-simulation).

**Meta-analysis.** Combining effect estimates across studies. [Meta analysis basics](#sec-chapters-15-metaanalysis-labs-lab-meta-analysis-basics).

**Mixed model.** Regression combining fixed and random effects. [Linear mixed models with lme4](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-linear-mixed-models-with-lme4).

**MNAR (missing not at random).** Missingness depends on unobserved values. [Mcar mar mnar](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-mcar-mar-mnar).

**Multiple imputation.** Imputing missing values several times and pooling the analyses. [Multiple imputation with mice](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-multiple-imputation-with-mice).

## N {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-n}

**Non-parametric.** A test or estimator that makes weak distributional assumptions. [Non parametric tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-non-parametric-tests).

## O {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-o}

**Odds ratio.** Ratio of odds between two groups; the natural scale for logistic regression. [Logistic regression binomial glm](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-logistic-regression-binomial-glm).

**Outlier.** An observation far from the bulk of the data. [Diagnostics residuals qq leverage cook s distance vif](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-diagnostics-residuals-qq-leverage-cook-s-distance-vif).

**Overdispersion.** Variance exceeding the model's nominal variance; common in Poisson regression. [Poisson and negative binomial regression](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-poisson-and-negative-binomial-regression).

## P {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-p}

**p-value.** Probability of data as or more extreme than observed, assuming the null. [Hypothesis testing p values type i ii errors](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-hypothesis-testing-p-values-type-i-ii-errors).

**Paired test.** A test comparing matched observations rather than independent samples. [Two sample and paired t tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-two-sample-and-paired-t-tests).

**PCA (principal components analysis).** Linear dimension reduction by orthogonal projection onto directions of maximum variance. [Pca factor analysis cca lda](#sec-chapters-08-multivariate-labs-lab-pca-factor-analysis-cca-lda).

**Permutation test.** Inference by shuffling labels to build a null distribution. [Bootstrap and permutation tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-bootstrap-and-permutation-tests).

**Poisson regression.** GLM with a log link for counts. [Poisson and negative binomial regression](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-poisson-and-negative-binomial-regression).

**Power.** Probability of detecting an effect if it exists; 1 − β. [Sample size power and quarto reporting](#sec-chapters-05-power-labs-lab-sample-size-power-and-quarto-reporting).

**Pre-registration.** A timestamped record of the research plan before data analysis. [Pre registration and statistical analysis plans](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-pre-registration-and-statistical-analysis-plans).

**Propensity score.** Probability of treatment given covariates. [Propensity scores and iptw](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-propensity-scores-and-iptw).

**Pseudoreplication.** Treating correlated observations as independent replicates. [Bench and translational design](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-bench-and-translational-design).

## R {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-r}

**Random effect.** A model coefficient treated as a draw from a distribution. [Linear mixed models with lme4](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-linear-mixed-models-with-lme4).

**Randomisation.** Allocating units to arms by a chance mechanism. [Randomised controlled trials](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-randomised-controlled-trials).

**Regression to the mean.** Tendency of extreme values to be closer to the mean on remeasurement. [Dichotomisation change scores regression to the mean](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-dichotomisation-change-scores-regression-to-the-mean).

**Reliability.** Consistency of repeated measurements. [Kappa icc bland altman](#sec-chapters-14-clinical-labs-lab-kappa-icc-bland-altman).

**Resampling.** Bootstrap, permutation, and cross-validation collectively. [Bootstrap and permutation tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-bootstrap-and-permutation-tests).

**Residual.** Observed minus predicted. [Diagnostics residuals qq leverage cook s distance vif](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-diagnostics-residuals-qq-leverage-cook-s-distance-vif).

**Risk ratio.** Ratio of event probabilities between two groups. [Two proportions chi square risk and odds](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-two-proportions-chi-square-risk-and-odds).

**Robust SE.** A standard error computed without assuming homoscedasticity. [Robust regression weighted ls hc sandwich standard errors](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-robust-regression-weighted-ls-hc-sandwich-standard-errors).

**ROC / AUC.** Receiver operating characteristic; area under it measures discrimination. [Calibration discrimination roc auc brier score](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-calibration-discrimination-roc-auc-brier-score).

## S {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-s}

**SAP (statistical analysis plan).** The formal plan for a trial's analysis, written before data are seen. [Pre registration and statistical analysis plans](#sec-chapters-16-design-labs-lab-pre-registration-and-statistical-analysis-plans).

**SE (standard error).** Standard deviation of a sampling distribution. [Populations samples and the central limit theorem](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-populations-samples-and-the-central-limit-theorem).

**SEM (standard error of the mean).** Standard error of a sample mean. [Populations samples and the central limit theorem](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-populations-samples-and-the-central-limit-theorem).

**Shapiro-Wilk.** A test of normality, powerful in small samples. [Two sample and paired t tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-two-sample-and-paired-t-tests).

**Spearman correlation.** Rank-based correlation. [Pearson and spearman correlation](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-pearson-and-spearman-correlation).

**Survival.** Time-to-event analysis. [Survival primer km log rank cox ph](#sec-chapters-11-survival-labs-lab-survival-primer-km-log-rank-cox-ph).

## T {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-t}

**Type I / II error.** False-positive and false-negative errors of a test. [Hypothesis testing p values type i ii errors](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-hypothesis-testing-p-values-type-i-ii-errors).

## V {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-v}

**VIF (variance inflation factor).** Measure of collinearity among regression predictors. [Diagnostics residuals qq leverage cook s distance vif](#sec-chapters-07-regression-labs-lab-diagnostics-residuals-qq-leverage-cook-s-distance-vif).

## W {#sec-appendices-b-glossary-w}

**Wilcoxon test.** Non-parametric test for paired (signed-rank) or unpaired (rank-sum) data. [Non parametric tests](#sec-chapters-04-inferential-labs-lab-non-parametric-tests).
